title: scRNA-seq single-sample analysis
text: dataset contain information 33694 genes. Many uninformative, may correlate. Dimension reduction methods PCA compress features space, reduce noise, improve computational efficiency. Normalisation reduces effect sequencing depth. Log transformation compresses data prevents highly expressed genes dominating downstream analysis. PCA linear transformatino, TSNE (UMAP, shown) non-linear, use mostly visualising. PCA TSNE, expect similar cell types group together. Sometimes, technical effects can outweight biological effects, batch effects, won’t cover today. can confirm using well-known gene markers CD3E (T cells), CD163 (myeloid cells) CD19 (B cells).
